content_length.limits: ASCII-pattern matches are not universal word counts or a measure of content depth, usefulness, ranking or AI citations. Configured bounds are editorial defaults, not engine requirements.

readability.limits: English-oriented heuristic formula estimates, not measured reader comprehension, a verified school grade, content quality or ranking/AI-citation impact. ASCII-pattern matches are not multilingual words; punctuation fragments are not verified sentences and vowel-group estimates are not validated syllables. Short samples, headings, abbreviations, code and specialist vocabulary can distort results. Review actual audience and text; no universal formula target or minimum word count is established.

lexical_focus.limits: ASCII frequency and exact term overlap only, not dominant topics, semantic relevance, intent satisfaction, rankings or AI citations. Top-8 cutoff/ties, synonyms, inflections, stopwords and extraction can hide matches; overlap does not establish semantic coverage.

authorship_cues.limits_note: Attribution candidates only: writer identity, rendered visibility, expertise, trust, author-link destinations and ranking impact are not verified. These bounded checks do not establish that attribution is absent.

date_cues.limits: Date-related candidates only, not validated dates, publication/update ownership, rendered visibility, content freshness, accuracy or ranking/citation impact. Metadata values and English-month/ISO-like text patterns can be unrelated or invalid. Bare years alone are not publication evidence. Non-observation in these bounded checks does not establish that the page lacks dates; structured-data date graphs are not inspected.

structured_data.rdfa_scope: bounded schema.org RDFa (not a full RDFa processor)

extraction_coverage.limits: Counts describe the supported extractor only, not complete JSON-LD/RDFa conformance, schema.org validity, visible-content ownership or Google eligibility. Warning-detail counts include retained omission notices, not all underlying errors. No known problem is not proof of exhaustive extraction. Known problems leave schema/overall score comparisons unverified; observed types remain observations, not evidence of absence.

jsonld_error_stages.limits: Exception-stage observations only, not full JSON/JSON-LD conformance, schema validity, exhaustive extraction or engine behavior. Missing legacy classification is not inferred.

article_field_policy.scope: Google Article-family field recommendations, not full eligibility or schema.org validity

geo_text_cues.limits: Not language understanding, paragraph segmentation, source validation, answer assessment or measured engine/ranking/citation behavior.
